scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm inquiring about the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a while back and I was wondering if you could update me on its current status and let me know if there are any updates or if it's still pending?
dialogue.agent: I've located your loan application. According to our records, the action taken on your loan application was that the loan was originated. This means your loan application was approved and the loan was funded. Would you like to know more details about your loan terms?

dialogue.user: That sounds great, I'm glad to hear that my loan application was approved and funded. Yes, I'd love to know more details about my loan terms. Can you tell me what my interest rate is and what are the total costs of the loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 5.99%. However, I don't have a value for the total loan costs in our records. Can I help you with anything else?

dialogue.user: That helps, thanks for letting me know the interest rate. I'm a bit concerned that you don't have the total loan costs in your records, but I'll move on for now. Can you tell me if there are any high-cost or HOEPA flags on my loan, and also has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: According to our records, your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA. And, yes, your loan was sold to an affiliate institution after origination. Is there anything else you'd like to know about your loan?

dialogue.user:
So my loan was sold to an affiliate institution, that's good to know. I think I've got most of the information I was looking for. One last question: what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application? Was it a factor in the approval process? 

(And then I might have enough to provide a rating
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio, or DTI, is 42%. This is the ratio of your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income. I can confirm that your DTI was considered in the credit decision, but I don't have information on the specific weight it was given in the approval process. I have answered all the questions I can based on your loan record.

dialogue.user:
I appreciate your help and the information you've provided. I think I have a good understanding of my loan now. I'm satisfied with the interaction and the information you were able to provide. 

<Satisfied> - I felt satisfied with the interaction. The agent was able to provide clear and accurate information about my loan application and terms, and was helpful in answering my questions.
